Go for Your Dream: Minako Becomes an Idol. Minako is close to realizing her lifelong dream of becoming an idol.

Crusade for the Galaxy: Legend of the Sailor Wars. Princess Kakyu explains that she has come to Earth in search of the Light of Hope.

Countdown to Destruction: The Sailor Guardians' Last Battle. The Sailor Star Lights go after Galaxia to avenge their fallen princess.
